summary_markdown: The discussion focused on potential advertising locations in Estonia. [p1] provided four specific digital ad unit links (DIGI 8013, DIGI 8012, DIGI 8014, and DIGI 8017). It was confirmed that the client requires tracking for both lanes of the road at these locations. The scope being considered is a pilot program covering all four listed locations with dual-lane coverage.
decisions: The pilot program must track both lanes at all specified Estonian locations.
